jobs.description_text: About the role AI Gateway gives developers one place to connect applications and agents to hundreds of models with one API key. You will be the Design Engineer for AI Gateway, owning product design and frontend implementation across those surfaces. This is a rare chance to use your product judgment, design craft, and code to shape a developer product and ship the experience yourself. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer II (Structures)
jobs.description_text: About This Role As the Manufacturing Engineer II - Structures at Varda, you will own the manufacturing processes for primary and secondary structural assemblies that form the backbone of our reentry capsules and spacecraft. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how parts are actually made, not just how they are designed, and who is energized by the challenge of scaling a complex aerospace manufacturing operation. This role is open at the Engineer II and Senior level, with levels determined based on candidate experience. jobs.title: Propulsion Components Engineer
jobs.description_text: About This Role Varda is hiring an experienced Propulsion Components Engineer to join the team that designs, builds, tests, and flies the fluid components on the W-Series satellite bus and future vehicles. The W-Series satellite incorporates a high-test hydrogen peroxide (HTP) and hydrocarbon bipropellant propulsion system with high-pressure inert gas pressurization and cold-gas attitude control. The component portfolio spans each of these fluid subsystems and includes solenoid control valves, check valves, relief valves, burst disks, fluid filters, regulators, manually operated service valves, machined fluid manifolds, and instrumentation including pressure transducers and RTDs. A successful candidate will take on a significant share of the component ownership for these mission-critical hardware articles as responsible engineer, helping expand component capabilities, improve reliability, and increase flight cadence. Many current Varda components are purchased parts, and you will be a primary technical interface to our suppliers. Varda also intends to bring more component design in-house for current and future vehicles, and you will help lead that transition: shaping make-versus-buy decisions, executing detailed design, and standing up the capabilities to develop, qualify, produce, acceptance test, and fly Varda-owned parts.
